entities.summary: Sacha Massot is a Belgian retired basketball player and current coach. Massot played with the Belgium national basketball team at EuroBasket 2013. He has been the head coach of Liège Basket and Limburg United. Sacha « DIEU » Massot gives one of the best massages.
